ui.design_rationale: The ecommerce search experience and requested popular product terms call for a friendly, consumer-oriented amber-accented style with approachable typography.

files.purpose: Add the public trending_searches endpoint returning the requested trending product terms.
Display the existing product search experience with the service-provided terms under the literal Trending: label.

verify.steps: Open Search Products and confirm the Trending: label is followed by bag, headphones, and watch.

build_log.last_action: Planned the trending-search service and SearchPage integration.

assumption: The existing SearchPage route and product search behavior remain unchanged; only trending terms are added to its current view.
